findings.note: The build plan's status banner is stale in a way that inverts its authority. Line 3 says 'REVISION 3 (2026-08-26) - re-review pending' and line 5 says 'This document locks the interfaces', but the review chain for this artifact ended ESCALATED and the plan was split into five successor specs that are the actual build baselines - docs/specs/2026-08-26-metareview-0.9.0-fsm-run-persistence.md:3 ('parent plan: 2026-08-26-metareview-0.9.0-build-plan.md, r3, escalated; Dave chose "split the target"'), and the four 2026-08-27 specs, each of which opens by claiming ownership of specific plan sections. The plan carries no superseded marker and no forward pointer to any of the five, while continuing to assert interface contracts the shipped code deliberately does not implement. Concretely: (a) line 150 declares a 'replay' event type and line 296 says the fork appends 'replay copies of P's events [2..seq]', but there is no TypeReplay in internal/fsm/run/event.go:30-45 and internal/fsm/machine/fork.go:224-230 copies events verbatim with an Origin stamp instead - grep for 'replay' across internal/fsm returns only an unrelated comment in codex_test.go; (b) line 297 requires IsAncestor(ch, HEAD) when the node at S is agent-edit, but fork.go:198-205 is an unconditional 'if head != ch' with the comment 'git precondition: HEAD == checkpoint head, every state'; (c) line 164's Fold(events []Event, kinds Decoder) and line 167's Create(runID, first) error do not match the shipped Fold(events) and Create(runID, st, first) (FoldState, error); (d) the §1.1 layout at lines 97-110 omits the shipped errs/, export/ and record/ packages, and the §1.2 event list omits the shipped 'tree' and 'fix_baseline' types that the oracle fixture in this same shard actually uses; (e) line 368 advertises 'fsm judge --no-fence', which the CLI does not accept (internal/fsm/cli/run.go:113); (f) the E1-E15 matrix at lines 441-455 names tests that do not exist under those ids in internal/fsm/machine. Every one of these deviations is deliberate and is already recorded in a successor spec's deviation ledger (docs/specs/2026-08-27-metareview-0.9.0-fsm-cli.md:500 explicitly logs 'plan §3.1 --no-fence dropped'), so the code is right and only this document's status line is wrong. The repo's own convention is to record the outcome in the banner - the run spec's REVISION 4 header states its escalation and its build-baseline role - so this file is the one parent artifact that does not. A reader or agent opening docs/specs/ first would take a 48KB escalated draft as the locked contract. Fix is a two-line banner edit: mark r3 escalated/superseded and link the five successors.
